key_insight: Cold-sprayed AA7075 MMC coatings can be substantially strengthened and made more wear- and corrosion-resistant by combining solid-state deposition with ceramic or nanocarbon reinforcements and post-processing.
engineering_relevance: The review is relevant for lightweight protective coatings in aerospace, defense, and space applications where repairability, durability, and multifunctional performance matter.
method: Cold spray AA7075 powders with reinforcements such as B4C, SiC, BNNPs/BNNTs, or GNPs.
Use surface engineering, functionally graded architectures, and hybrid reinforcement designs to tailor microstructure and properties.
Apply densification/post-treatments such as heat treatment or hot isostatic pressing to improve bonding and reduce porosity.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes reported improvements in mechanical strength, wear resistance, corrosion behavior, and radiation-shielding performance across recent studies, but does not present a single new dataset.
watch_item: Key implementation risks are reinforcement dispersion, interface integrity, and process-window optimization, which can limit repeatability and scale-up.
paper_title: Recent Advances in Cold-Sprayed Aluminum Alloy 7075 Metal Matrix Composite Coatings: Surface Engineering, Feedstock Design, Post-Processing Strategies, and Emerging Applications
